objective: Discover a psoriasis-derived fibroblast-oriented program using only non-RA human longitudinal data, then test transfer in two RA fibroblast study families and an isolated RA treatment holdout.

candidate_nomination_provenance.nomination_role: identifier and hypothesis pool only; no historical RA result or current RA numeric value may enter V15 source scoring

non_ra_source.eligible_gene: official GPL570 annotation has exactly one current gene symbol; symbol is present in both RA development gene universes
non_ra_source.probe_to_gene: arithmetic mean of all eligible probes mapped to the symbol
non_ra_source.source_value_scale: use submitter-processed series-matrix values without result-dependent transformation

baseline.module_score: gene-wise z across the 130 baseline samples, equal gene mean
baseline.model: paired module delta = intercept + paired fibroblast-proxy delta + paired immune-proxy delta + paired keratinocyte-proxy delta

week12.samples: 38 secukinumab and 24 placebo donors with paired BL.LS/W12.LS
week12.module_score: gene-wise z across all BL.LS and W12.LS samples in the randomized week-12 analysis
week12.model: within-donor module change = intercept + secukinumab_indicator + fibroblast-proxy change + immune-proxy change + keratinocyte-proxy change
week12.permutation: 10000 arm-label permutations with seed 20260815; donor changes remain intact

week52_support.samples: original secukinumab arm with paired BL.LS/W52.LS

module_generation.universe: all four-gene combinations from the feasible fixed 59-gene nomination pool
module_generation.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over every estimable combination separately for baseline-adjusted and week12-adjusted p values; non-estimable combinations occupy p=1 slots
module_generation.ranking: ascending max source q, then descending minimum absolute adjusted t statistic, then descending coherence, then lexicographic gene tuple

ra_development.normalization: median-of-ratios size factors; log2(normalized count+0.5); gene-wise z within cohort; equal four-gene mean
ra_development.primary_test: two-sided Welch t test RA versus control
ra_development.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the complete frozen source family separately in each cohort; non-estimable candidates retain p=1 slots

matched_random.matching: gene mean-expression quintile by variance quintile

portfolio.ranking: ascending Fisher combined p, then ascending maximum RA q, then ascending source rank
portfolio.redundancy: greedy selection permits at most two shared genes between selected modules

terminal_holdout.authorization: numeric target values remain unread until the confirmatory portfolio, official GPL570 probe map, samples, directions, tests and thresholds are sealed
terminal_holdout.scoring: official GPL570 single-symbol probe map frozen before numeric read; gene-wise z across 24 samples; equal module mean
terminal_holdout.multiplicity: BH across the entire frozen confirmatory portfolio for paired-t and sign-flip p values separately

novelty_after_numeric_pass.pass_class: N1 or N2; no prior exact module and no prior identical causal/intervention chain
novelty_after_numeric_pass.boundary: bounded comprehensive audit does not prove universal absence

prohibitions: using any current RA numeric value to generate or rerank the V15 source family
dropping failed or non-estimable candidates from multiplicity slots
changing genes, weights, mappings, directions, tests or thresholds after the corresponding freeze
rescuing a failed candidate with a post-result endpoint
claiming single-gene causality from program-level evidence
